title: She Sewed the Blue Angels’ Suits for 40 Years. Then a Big Company Got the Job.
summary: Jellie Whitehurst in Pensacola, Fla., was surprised to learn that after decades, the Navy had awarded a $1.7 million contract to a company in Virginia to supply the gear.
